description: Project scaffolding and green baseline for the whole platform: a FastAPI backend skeleton (Python 3.11, uv, SQLite), a Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) web dashboard skeleton with the cohesive green/white + forest + Mussoorie/Uttarakhand hill-town design system, shared tooling, the external-service adapter interfaces with working local/fallback implementations, and a single root demo command that launches BOTH the API and the website. The ENTIRE product is a website: every subsystem added in later features is a page/route in this one Next.js app, served through the API. This feature establishes the skeleton that compiles, lints, and tests green with no features yet.
steps: Create repo root files: README.md (project overview, architecture diagram-in-text, Deep vs Minimal feature map, and the SINGLE documented demo command per Req 34.1), CONTRIBUTING.md, .gitignore (python + node + .env + sqlite db), .env.example documenting ALL external config and feature flags (LLM_API_*, WHATSAPP_* provider+signing-secret, GEOCODER_*, SENTIMENT_MODEL_*, PII_ENCRYPTION_KEY, PSEUDONYM_SALT, SESSION_SECRET) per Req 32.2 — real values never committed.

Create a root Makefile with targets: `setup` (backend uv sync + frontend npm install), `test`, `lint`, `build`, and `demo`. Create scripts/demo.sh invoked by `make demo` that (for now) just starts the API and the Next.js dev/prod server concurrently and prints the dashboard URL. Later features extend it to seed data and run the scripted scenario.

Backend scaffold under backend/: pyproject.toml (deps: fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings, sqlalchemy, aiosqlite, python-jose or pyjwt, passlib[argon2], hypothesis+pytest+pytest-asyncio+ruff as dev). Add backend/.python-version = 3.11.15. Create app/main.py with FastAPI app, CORS for the frontend origin, a public GET /health endpoint and a public WhatsApp webhook placeholder (the only two unauthenticated endpoints per Req 30.1), and router registration wiring (empty routers for now).

Backend core under backend/app/core/: config.py (pydantic-settings reading env, with boolean/enum feature flags that select real-vs-fallback adapter implementations and sensible local defaults so the app runs with NO third-party creds), db.py (async SQLAlchemy engine + session, SQLite file under data/ by default), and placeholder audit.py and security.py modules.

Backend adapter interfaces under backend/app/adapters/ — define abstract interfaces AND working local/fallback implementations selected by config: sentiment.py (SentimentEngine interface + deterministic lexicon/heuristic fallback that will be fleshed out later; real MuRIL/IndicBERT adapter stub behind same interface), llm.py (LLMClient interface + deterministic template fallback that labels output template-generated per Req 34.3/12.9), whatsapp.py (WhatsAppGateway interface + in-process mock recording outbound and simulating inbound, with real HMAC signature verification helper per Req 20.4), voice.py (VoicePipeline interface + stub), geocoder.py (Geocoder interface + local-gazetteer-first impl). Each must be import-safe and unit-testable offline.

Add a trivial backend unit test (e.g. tests/test_health.py hitting /health and tests/test_adapters.py asserting fallback adapters are selected by default) so `uv run pytest` passes with at least one green test.

Frontend scaffold under frontend/ with Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS. Build the themed DESIGN SYSTEM as a first-class deliverable (per explicit user emphasis): tailwind.config.ts and app/globals.css define a green/white palette with a forest accent and Mussoorie/Uttarakhand hill-town visual identity (deep forest greens, misty off-whites, pine/ridge motifs). Create lib/theme.ts with design tokens, and a reusable component library in components/ui/ (Button, Card, Badge, StatTile, Table, PageHeader) plus an app-shell layout (components/layout/ with a sidebar navigating to every subsystem page and a header). The shell must render consistently across ALL routes.

Create placeholder routes for every subsystem so the website structure is visible end-to-end from day one: app/(dashboard)/page.tsx (Metrics Overview home), /market-radar, /time-machine, /what-if, /playbook, /gap-finder, /destination, /checkout-shield, /complaints, /guest-compass, /concierge, /benchmark. Each is a themed placeholder page using the design system; later features fill them in. Add lib/api.ts (typed fetch client pointing at the FastAPI base URL from env).
Add a frontend lint config and a minimal component test (vitest + React Testing Library) e.g. rendering a design-system component, so `npm run lint`, `npm run build` and `npm test` all pass.
Make the FIRST git commit on main (local only, do NOT push) with all scaffolding.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && uv sync` succeeds and `uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` passes with at least one green test.
`cd frontend && npm install && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` all succeed.

The Next.js app renders an app shell with the green/white + forest + hill-town theme and a sidebar linking to a placeholder page for every subsystem (market-radar, time-machine, what-if, playbook, gap-finder, destination, checkout-shield, complaints, guest-compass, concierge, benchmark, metrics home).
GET /health returns 200 and is unauthenticated; the WhatsApp webhook route exists and is unauthenticated; all other API routers are registered.
Default config selects fallback/mock implementations for sentiment, LLM, WhatsApp, voice and geocoder so the app starts with NO third-party credentials.
.env.example documents every external/config variable and no real secret is committed anywhere.
`make demo` starts both the API and the website and prints the dashboard URL.
A single local git commit exists on main (not pushed).
verification: Run `cd backend && uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` and confirm all pass.
Run `cd frontend && npm install && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` and confirm all pass.
Start the app via `make demo` (or start API + `npm run dev`) and confirm the themed dashboard shell and all placeholder subsystem routes load without error.
findings: Scaffolded the full green baseline. Backend: Python pinned to 3.11.15 via uv (`uv python pin`), pyproject uses `[dependency-groups]` (not deprecated `[tool.uv].dev-dependencies`). Ruff enforced StrEnum and datetime.UTC on py311; config enums are StrEnum. 11 pytest tests pass, ruff clean. Frontend: Next.js 14.2.33 + React 18 + Tailwind 3, App Router with a `(dashboard)` route group whose layout renders the shared AppShell (sidebar links to all 12 pages + header). Design system in components/ui (Button, Card, Badge, StatTile, Table, PageHeader) with the green/white forest + Mussoorie theme in tailwind.config.ts, globals.css and lib/theme.ts. Note: the native DOM `title` attribute conflicted with Card's ReactNode `title` prop, fixed with `Omit<..., 'title'>`. Lint, build (15 routes) and 2 vitest tests pass. `make demo` verified: starts API (GET /health -> 200, unauthenticated) + Next.js website (200) concurrently and prints the dashboard URL http://localhost:3000. WhatsApp webhook is public and verifies HMAC-SHA256 (Req 20.4). All adapters default to local fallbacks (sentiment/llm/whatsapp/voice/geocoder) so the app runs with no third-party creds. .env.example documents all config; no real secrets committed. First local commit made on main (not pushed).
